answer: Because the jetty solution is checked at the willow gate and logged, the mirror audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 27 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The fee repeats 15 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
